title.narrative: Power to You(th)

description.narrative: The Power to You(th) partnership unites Amref Flying Doctors, Rutgers and Sonke Gender Justice (Sonke), all established organisations with synergetic expertise, geographic footprint and networks. This partnership forms a Consortium that believes change starts in communities. To trigger this change, we will strengthen civil society organisations (CSOs) to empower and increase the voice of adolescent girls and young women (AGYW). The Consortium fosters ownership at the country level, with locally formed coalitions and representation of beneficiaries in our governance. As the lead, Amref Flying Doctors, in collaboration with Amref Health Africa (AHA), has always worked from the premise that priorities are set in Africa and that communities drive change.

recipient-country.narrative: This combines global + Netherlands specific activities.

policy-marker.narrative: The focus of the Power to You(th) programme lies on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR).
